display_name: iShares Core MSCI EAFE ETF (Ondo Tokenized)

about.en: IEFAon is the Ondo tokenized ETF for the iShares Core MSCI EAFE ETF (IEFA), BlackRock's fund of developed-market equities outside the US and Canada, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by IEFA fund shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding IEFA with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one fund share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0xFEFf7a377A86462F5a2A872009722C154707F09e), BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of the fund shares.
